answer: During a cross-cluster data voyage, an agent economy can deter sybil rings by making veterans cosign newcomers with a 250-coin voucher stake before any newcomer can rent memory near the sable exchange or bid on anchor tasks. An honest sponsor backs 1 newcomer for 12 hours and gets 100% of its stake returned once a 67% quorum threshold passes the hash proof audit. Vouching for 1,000 fake accounts ties up 250,000 coins and 12,000 sponsor-hours, while any caught fraud is slashed and forfeited. This fails if a silent cartel farms standing for months before attacking together.
